text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was utterly helpless. I can't go on like 
this, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's because of my weak heart... If only 
I had fought back harder...!"
choice_data_list: Let's use that feeling as fuel.

Then let's work even harder than ever 
before!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Yer right, I know why I lost. Then all I 
gotta do is conquer my weaknesses...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you can do this, me! I'll make my 
mind and body even stronger, and next 
time, I'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If I'm weak, I just gotta get 
stronger...! So I don't lose in spirit or 
in a race, I gotta do more!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please lend me a hand! Next time, 
I'll sink my teeth into victory for sure!
